description: This file contains utility functions, constants, and type definitions for managing subagents, including session handling, command resolution, and message processing in a chat-based system.

methods.name: compactLine
methods.description: Replaces multiple whitespace characters with a single space and trims the string.

methods.name: formatTaskPreview
methods.description: Creates a truncated preview of a task string, limited to SUBAGENT_TASK_PREVIEW_MAX characters.

methods.name: resolveDisplayStatus
methods.description: Determines the display status of a subagent run, indicating if it is active, waiting, or failed.

methods.name: formatSubagentListLine
methods.description: Generates a formatted string representing a subagent run, including label, status, runtime, and task preview.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp in milliseconds to an ISO string or 'n/a' if invalid.

methods.name: formatTimestampWithAge
methods.description: Formats a timestamp with its age relative to current time.

methods.name: stopWithText
methods.description: Returns a command handler result to stop processing with a specific text reply.

methods.name: stopWithUnknownTargetError
methods.description: Returns a command handler result indicating an unknown subagent error.

methods.name: resolveSubagentTarget
methods.description: Resolves a subagent target from a list of runs and a token, with error handling.

methods.name: resolveSubagentEntryForToken
methods.description: Resolves a subagent entry for a given token, or returns an error reply if not found.

methods.name: resolveRequesterSessionKey
methods.description: Determines the session key of the requester, with optional preference logic.

methods.name: resolveCommandSubagentController
methods.description: Resolves the subagent controller session and capabilities based on requester key.

methods.name: resolveHandledPrefix
methods.description: Identifies the command prefix from a normalized string.

methods.name: resolveSubagentsAction
methods.description: Determines the subagent action based on command prefix and tokens.

methods.name: resolveFocusTargetSession
methods.description: Resolves the focus target session, either a subagent or via gateway resolution.

methods.name: buildSubagentsHelp
methods.description: Returns a help string listing subagent commands and usage.

methods.name: extractMessageText
methods.description: Extracts role and text content from a chat message, sanitizing if role is 'assistant'.

methods.name: formatLogLines
methods.description: Formats an array of chat messages into labeled log lines.

methods.name: loadSubagentSessionEntry
methods.description: Loads a session entry for a subagent, with caching and path resolution.
